content:
- Model consistently underestimates prices in the early part of the forecast horizon, especially for the first 5–10 days.
- Overestimates after sharp price spikes (e.g., post-73.00+), often overshooting by 2–5% and failing to correct downward.
- Shows persistent downward bias in the middle-to-late forecast window, particularly when true prices exhibit mean reversion or consolidation.
- Tends to lag behind true price movements by 1–3 days, especially in downward trends.
- Overreacts to recent volatility, producing exaggerated swings in forecasts that don’t align with historical volatility patterns.
- Underestimates the magnitude of price rebounds after corrections, especially in the final 5–10 days of the forecast.
- Fails to capture the “tail” of price distributions — often underestimates the true high end of the range, especially in bullish scenarios.
